name: Apply for a Blue Badge (disabled person's parking permit)

pages.questionText: What is the full name of the person the badge is for?
pages.hintText: Give the name of the disabled person, even if you are applying on their behalf.

pages.questionText: What is their date of birth?
What is their home address?
pages.hintText: The badge is issued by the council for this address.

pages.questionText: Who is this application for?
pages.hintText: This decides which eligibility questions you will be asked.

selectionOptions.name: An organisation that transports disabled people

routing.answerValue: An organisation that transports disabled people

pages.questionText: How far can the child walk without stopping or severe difficulty?
pages.hintText: Only asked for a child aged 3 to 16.

pages.questionText: Which of these apply when the child is travelling?

selectionOptions.name: Uses bulky medical equipment that cannot be carried around
Is a danger to themselves or others near moving traffic
Needs constant supervision for a medical condition

pages.questionText: How does the applicant qualify for a Blue Badge?
pages.hintText: Some benefits mean you qualify automatically. Otherwise the council arranges an assessment.

pages.questionText: Which qualifying benefit does the applicant receive?
pages.hintText: Only asked when qualifying through a benefit.

selectionOptions.name: Disability Living Allowance (DLA), higher rate mobility

routing.answerValue: Disability Living Allowance (DLA), higher rate mobility

pages.questionText: How many points did the applicant score for the PIP 'moving around' activity?
pages.hintText: Only asked for PIP. 8 or more points qualifies automatically.

pages.questionText: During a mobility assessment, how is the applicant's walking affected?
pages.hintText: Choose the option that best describes most journeys.

pages.questionText: Do any of these other conditions apply?
pages.hintText: Select all that apply. Choosing 'None of these' with no walking difficulty means the applicant is not eligible.

selectionOptions.name: Severe upper-limb disability, drives but cannot use parking meters
Hidden disability causing very significant difficulty walking
Terminal illness that seriously limits mobility

routing.answerValue: Severe upper-limb disability, drives but cannot use parking meters
Hidden disability causing very significant difficulty walking
Terminal illness that seriously limits mobility

pages.questionText: Which medical statements apply to the child aged 2 or under?

selectionOptions.name: Must always be near a vehicle for emergency medical treatment
Must have bulky medical equipment carried at all times

pages.questionText: Name and address of the applicant's GP or medical specialist
pages.hintText: Optional. Helps the council confirm a medical condition.

pages.questionText: How will you provide a photo for the badge?
pages.hintText: The badge shows a photo of the disabled person.

selectionOptions.name: Bring one to the council office
Reuse the photo from a previous badge

pages.questionText: If this is a renewal, what is the previous badge number?
pages.hintText: Optional. Leave blank for a first application.

pages.questionText: Do you confirm the information given is true and complete?
pages.hintText: You must confirm to submit a personal application.

pages.questionText: What is the name of the organisation?
pages.hintText: Only asked for an organisation application.

pages.questionText: How many disabled people does the organisation care for or transport?
What is the organisation's contact email address?
Does the organisation meet the conditions for an organisational Blue Badge?
pages.hintText: The vehicles must be used mainly to transport disabled people.
